text: The BetItalyPay brand's website is published under the company details of GI.LU.PI. S.r.l. a S.U., a single-member company with registered office in Tricase, in the province of Lecce, whose PEC address (gilupi@arubapec.it) the same page lists under contacts.
short: BetItalyPay is run by GI.LU.PI. S.r.l. of Tricase (Lecce)
